cellular_manifestation: Lifeforce is manifested at the cellular level as cellular charge[cite: 3].

healthspan_definition: Healthspan is the number of years we live in good physical, mental, and metabolic health[cite: 3].
The focus is on quality of life, staying active, independent, and disease-free for longer[cite: 3].
